schema_prefix.title: Destination schema prefix
schema_prefix.description: Destination schema prefix. Prefix for each replicated schema. For example with prefix 'x', source schemas 'foo' and 'bar' get replicated as 'x_foo' and 'x_bar'. The prefix is permanent and cannot be changed after connection creation

client_id.description: `Client ID` of your Airtable client application.

client_secret.description: `Client Secret` of your Airtable client application.

refresh_token.description: The long-lived refresh token along with the client ID and client secret carry the information necessary to get a new access token for API resources.
